title: 주문등록 초안 셀 이동 및 주문 내역서 표시

actions.name: MOVE_QUANTITY_FOCUS
actions.rule: Only focus changes; displayed row order and Box/bunch/stem column order. No quantity change at boundaries.

actions.name: WRAP_ORDER_SUMMARY_NAME
actions.rule: Show the complete original product label, wrapping within the summary pane.

actions.name: SELECT_ORDER_SCOPE_AND_RECALL
actions.rule: Collapse on selection; reopen without clearing. Previous-order reads use exact customer/year/week and advance the exclusive beforeWeek cursor. Change history uses selected year/week and exact name.

crossYearFixture.expectation: Both years' orders remain unchanged: moving focus or wrapping a name sends no request. Same 45-01 in the prior year cannot be selected by the previous-order read or current order lookup.

customerOrdering.customer: descending last order date, null last, equal dates by name then key
customerOrdering.manager: first occurrence in recency-sorted customers = latest order among assigned customers

weekSelection.selection: collapse immediately, including before customer selection; focus reopen button
weekSelection.otherWeeks: existing complete year/week dropdown under Other weeks

sameWeekNewWindow.target: new independent window for every click
sameWeekNewWindow.initialization: once on router ready; requireOrderYear validates exact year/week; customer picker open and focused; preserve selected customer manager or current manager filter
sameWeekNewWindow.draft: new customer and empty quantity draft in child; parent preserved

summaryQuantityEditing.immediate: loaded items editable without selecting their group; totals/catalog inputs update together
summaryQuantityEditing.empty: keep focused row until editing ends; blank draft represents zero
summaryQuantityEditing.writes: only existing explicit Save sends request
